title: Partner outreach — quick capture (evening)
content:
Evening capture after calls + quick checklist dump

Context: short daily scratch for partner outreach flow. Not polished — just the bits I need to remember tomorrow.

10:00 AM call — BrightMarket (initial integration sync)
- Attendees: Sam (BrightMarket eng), Priya (PM), Jordan (us, notes), me
- BrightMarket wants: marketplace listing + hosted API connector (they want to allow customers to route to a Redwood-hosted model via their UI)
- Key asks: simple level of control for model selection, ability to set per-tenant rate limits, clear data residency (EU only for pilot)
- Tech constraints: they use a serverless backend (fastly + node) and prefer API-key style auth; they also want webhook event for usage/billing spikes
- Next meeting: Wed 2026-03-18, 11:30 PT for end-to-end demo

Immediate action items (me / next 48h):
1) Draft a small integration checklist for BrightMarket (deliverable: one-pager + cURL quickstart). Owner: Ava. Due: 2026-03-14
   - Items to include: API key creation, sample request for chat/streaming, model pinning example, rate-limit headers to expect, error codes map
2) Spin up a throwaway test key in hosted sandbox and run BrightMarket sample requests (validate CORS, streaming) — Owner: Jordan (cc'd) — tag: JIRA-PLAT-423
3) Confirm EU-only tenancy options (private pilot) with infra — ping @Infra SRE on Slack, ask about region pinning + KMS scoping — Due: EOD 2026-03-13
4) Privacy checklist: include guidance on no-PII default redaction for the marketplace listing + contracts team review (Legal) — add Confluence link to partner page

Integration design notes (rough):
- Auth: they prefer API-key; offer both API-key and OAuth flow (we should document both). For marketplace listing, provide server-to-server API key rotation advice.
- Routing: propose agency-routing tag in requests (x-redwood-tenant: brightmarket) so usage shows up on their billing dashboard. Also propose a fallback route to a lower-cost quantized variant when capacity high.
- Model selection UX: default to 'redwood-chat-ggml-7b' for pilot (cost/capacity trade-off), offer 'redwood-llama-13b' as optional. Note: confirm memory/KV cache behavior with infra.
- Billing: need hourly + per-token estimate for demo; ask finance for quick estimate sheet (copy from marketplace-kit)

Potential blockers / unknowns:
- Legal: data processing addendum for EU residency (who signs, timeline)
- BrightMarket wants a 2-week turnaround on a demo — might be tight if infra needs region pinning
- Their UI requires streaming tokens every 200ms — need to validate our streaming latency in their stack

Low-effort quick wins to show tomorrow:
- Provide a one-page 'how it will look' (flow diagram) using ascii mockup (I can sketch)
- Create a sample code snippet (Node fetch + streaming) and attach to PRD
- Pre-fill a short marketplace listing draft (2 paragraphs + bullets) that marketing can tweak

Notes to self (random):
- Slack threads: #ecosystem (pin), #partners (notify Jordan re infra ping)
- Attach sample billing proof from previous marketplace pilot (search Confluence: marketplace-pilot-2025)
- Remind legal to check standard DPA clause: "no model training on customer data" — we should recommend explicit language for marketplace entries

Meeting follow-ups (actionable lines to add to invite):
- Demo scope: chat-only vs embeddings + expected RPS (ask them to provide 2 sample flows)
- Acceptance criteria: successful demo with EU region, streaming < 200ms latency, and per-tenant rate limiting in place
- People: include Infra lead and Legal rep on demo call

Daily personal TODO (short):
- [ ] Finish integration checklist one-pager (30–45m)
- [ ] Create test key + run smoke tests (Jordan parallel)
- [ ] Slack infra & legal, tag in doc links
- [ ] Draft marketplace listing + send to marketing for copy edits
- [ ] Add follow-up meeting notes to JIRA ticket JIRA-PLAT-423

Brainstorm / reminders (looser):
- Could we make a tiny SDK wrapper for BrightMarket that abstracts tenant header + retry logic? Maybe a micro-sample repo they can fork.
- Consider an automatic demo mode with synthetic traffic so we can demo burst behavior without provisioning dedicated capacity.
- If pilot looks promising, propose a "partner success" milestone: 1 month free dedicated capacity for first 3 paying customers via BrightMarket (proposal to revenue ops)

End of day thought: keep checklist laser-focused — they want demo not docs. Demo wins trust. Docs come later.

-------------------
